contract: WithPermissionClockMonitor accepts one caller-constructed unstarted monitor. Option resolution starts no clock work and rejects either external permission-clock callback with a managed monitor.
Open starts the monitor before required source startup and takes ownership only after successful monitor startup.
Failed Open cancels its owned monitor. A failed attempt to claim a monitor owned by another runtime preserves the first owner.
Runtime Close joins the monitor worker inside its existing five-second bound. The monitor refuses cached reads when the runtime context ends.
ReadPermissionClock uses only the managed cache. Successful reads pass a zero-allocation assertion.
An origin can supply the same monitor.Read to OriginConfig.Clock. Receipt issuance and shutdown use that clock.
PermissionClockStatus exposes local diagnostics without an observation. Public hosts must redact LastError.
